paragraphs: Archana is a savory person. Salty, spicy, crunchy. That is her happy place.
I have a sweet tooth. Not a small one. An extreme one.
So the sweets you see here are on me. I make them. I also eat them. Rigorous quality control, one more spoonful at a time.
Archana handles the savory. I handle the dessert. Some couples split the chores. We split the flavors.
